pass.title: Propose closing 1 delivered GitHub issue(s); 1 need a look
pass.description:
To close issues, attach the approved set and finish the gate step: lc attach STEP approved '{"issues": ["owner/repo#N"]}' --replace, then lc done STEP approved. To close nothing, attach {"issues": []} and lc done STEP declined.

Proposed closes
kenmclennan/lightcycle
- [kenmclennan/lightcycle#12](https://github.com/kenmclennan/lightcycle/issues/12) Inbox hides parked steps - LC-1301 (done, completed) PR #1013
